highlights: As a voice interaction entry, the XiaoZhi AI chatbot leverages the AI capabilities of large models like Qwen / DeepSeek, and achieves multi-terminal control via the MCP protocol.
You can switch to v1 by running git checkout v1.
Device-side MCP for device control (Speaker, LED, Servo, GPIO, etc.)
Cloud-side MCP to extend large model capabilities (smart home control, PC desktop operation, knowledge search, email, etc.)
The firmware connects to the official xiaozhi.me server by default.
